about: Every input the presence fix of 2026-10-22 (branch fix-b-presence) regressed, from the differential audit B-presence (58 regressions, with their founder-message variants). A made-up life is read only when the founder's message asks about the coach's own weekend, day, week, holiday, evening or plans (packages/ai/src/validators/asked-life.ts); every case here must come out exactly as origin/main left it. packages/ai/src/validators/asked-life.test.ts checks the reply rewrite (typed and spoken) and the sentence gate (typed and on a call) with the founder's message against the same without it (what main does: without such a question nothing changed); 'gate' is what main's gate shows where the regression was the streamed path. evals/tests/test_matrix_checks.py checks the matrix presence check (G14, presence_claim with the founder's message and the turn's small-talk intent) against main's 'g14'. 'rewritten' marks the five where the founder asked how the coach's weekend was and the reply made one up: their regression was the grader's verdict, which stays main's; the reply now loses the made-up weekend (evals MX-0032).
